mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.selectMyComplexList 나의 단지 목록 */ 'M' AS IS_MINE , A.CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , A.PLOT_LOC AS PLOT_LOC , A.BULDNM AS BULDNM , A.CPLXNM AS CPLXNM , A.ARCD AS ARCD , A.LEGCD AS LEGCD , A.CPLX_TY AS CPLX_TY , B.CODE_NM AS CPLX_TY_NM , A.CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS CPLX_HSHLD_CO , A.CPLX_DONG_CO AS CPLX_DONG_CO , DATE_FORMAT( A.CREAT_DT, '%Y.%m.%d' ) AS CRDE FROM TB_BRK_COMPLEX A INNER JOIN TB_CM_COMMCODE B ON A.CPLX_TY = B.MXTR_COMM_CD WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd} AND A.BRKNO = #{brkno} /* 다세대, 빌딩, 상가건물, 기타건물 제외 */ AND A.CPLX_TY NOT IN ( 'EST116', 'EST124', 'EST122', 'EST125')

SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.selectOthersComplexList 타중개사 단지목록 */ 'O' AS IS_MINE , A.CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , A.PLOT_LOC AS PLOT_LOC , A.BULDNM AS BULDNM , A.CPLXNM AS CPLXNM , A.ARCD AS ARCD , A.LEGCD AS LEGCD , A.CPLX_TY AS CPLX_TY , B.CODE_NM AS CPLX_TY_NM , A.CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS CPLX_HSHLD_CO , A.CPLX_DONG_CO AS CPLX_DONG_CO , DATE_FORMAT( A.CREAT_DT, '%Y.%m.%d' ) AS CRDE FROM TB_BRK_COMPLEX A INNER JOIN TB_CM_COMMCODE B ON A.CPLX_TY = B.MXTR_COMM_CD WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd} AND A.BRKNO != #{brkno} /* 다세대, 빌딩, 상가건물, 기타건물 제외 */ AND A.CPLX_TY NOT IN ( 'EST116', 'EST124', 'EST122', 'EST125')

SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.selectTotalComplexList 미등록단지 전체목록 */ A.CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , A.PLOT_LOC AS PLOT_LOC , NVL(B.BULDNO, 0) AS BULDNO , NVL(B.BRKNO , 0) AS BRKNO , A.BULDNM AS BULDNM , A.CPLXNM AS CPLXNM , A.ARCD AS ARCD , A.LEGCD AS LEGCD , CASE WHEN B.CPLX_TY IS NULL OR B.CPLX_TY = '' THEN 'CPX999' ELSE B.CPLX_TY END AS CPLX_TY , CASE WHEN B.CPLX_TY IS NULL OR B.CPLX_TY = '' THEN ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM_COMMCODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'CPX' AND COMM_CD = '999' ) ELSE ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM_COMMCODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'EST' AND MXTR_COMM_CD = B.CPLX_TY ) END AS CPLX_TY_NM , A.CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS CPLX_HSHLD_CO , A.CPLX_DONG_CO AS CPLX_DONG_CO , DATE_FORMAT( A.CREAT_DT, '%Y.%m.%d' ) AS CRDE , CASE WHEN B.BRKNO = #{brkno} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_MINE FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX A LEFT JOIN TB_BRK_COMPLEX B ON A.CPLXNO = B.CPLXNO WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd}

SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.selectComplexinfo 단지 통합정보 조회 */ A.CPLXNO, A.BULDNO, A.BRKNO , A.CPLXNM , A.ARCD, A.LEGCD , ( SELECT ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE ARCODE = A.ARCD AND LEGCODE = A.LEGCD ) AS ARNAME , B.PLOT_LOC , B.BULD_NM AS BULDNM , DATE_FORMAT(C.PRMISS_DE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS PRMISSDE /* 승인일자 */ , TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, STR_TO_DATE(C.PRMISS_DE, '%Y%m%d'), CURDATE()) AS DIFFY /* 현재년도 - 승인년도 */ , A.CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS HSHLDCO /* 단지내 총 세대수 */ , A.CPLX_DONG_CO AS DONGCO /* 단지내 총 동수 */ , 0 AS MARKETCO /* 단지내 상가동 수 */ , D.RDNG_ELVTR_CO AS ELVTRCO /* 엘레베이터 수(비상용 제외) */ FROM TB_BRK_COMPLEX A INNER JOIN TB_BD_TITLE_LEDGR B ON A.BULDNO = B.BULD_REGSTR_PK INNER JOIN TB_BD_TITLE_LEDGR_PRMISS_DE C ON A.BULDNO = C.BULD_REGSTR_PK INNER JOIN TB_BD_TITLE_LEDGR_UNIT_CO D ON A.BULDNO = D.BULD_REGSTR_PK WHERE A.BRKNO = #{brkno} AND A.BULDNO = #{buldno}
mapper.insert: INSERT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.insertHbdBuldStuff 중개사물건(건물)등록 */ INTO TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF ( BULDNO, BRKNO, ARCD, LEGCD, CPLXNO, BULDNM, ESTCD, T_HSHLDCO, T_DONGCO , LOC_X, LOC_Y , CREAT_USER_NO, UPDT_USER_NO ) SELECT #{buldno} AS BULDNO , #{brkno} AS BRKNO , ARCD AS ARCD , LEGCD AS LEGCD , CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , BULDNM AS BULDNM , #{cplxTy} AS ESTCD , CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS T_HSHLDCO , CPLX_DONG_CO AS T_DONGCO , #{x} AS LOC_X , #{y} AS LOC_Y , #{brkno} AS CREAT_USER_NO , #{brkno} AS UPDT_USER_NO FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX WHERE HBD_CPLXNO = #{cplxno}

INSERT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerComplexMapper.insertBrokerComplex 중개사 단지등록 */ INTO TB_BRK_COMPLEX ( CPLXNO , BULDNO , BRKNO , PLOT_LOC , CPLXNM , BULDNM , ARCD , LEGCD , CPLX_TY , CPLX_HSHLD_CO , CPLX_DONG_CO , LOC_X , LOC_Y , CREAT_USER_NO , UPDT_USER_NO ) SELECT CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , ( SELECT BULDNO FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX_BULD WHERE CPLXNO = #{cplxno} AND REPRE_BULD_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) , #{brkno} AS BRKNO , PLOT_LOC AS PLOT_LOC , CPLXNM AS CPLX_NM , BULDNM AS BULD_NM , ARCD AS ARCD , LEGCD AS LEGCD , #{cplxTy} AS CPLX_TY , CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS CPLX_HSHLD_CO , CPLX_DONG_CO AS CPLX_DONG_CO , #{x} AS LOC_X , #{y} AS LOC_Y , #{brkno} AS CREAT_USER_NO , #{brkno} AS UPDT_USER_NO FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX A WHERE CPLXNO = #{cplxno}
